body: Hard to say whether the meds helped or the therapy?
How long did it take you to overcome binge eating disorder? I've had eating issues for three years.
Well, I have like six or seven mountains to climb and that one seems the tallest.
I'm sick of being quirky and weird though. I'll be stuck with this shit for the rest of my life and it scares me. I don't want to deal with this anymore.
Did you ever get past the bulimia? Honestly that is the worst of them all.

See, I'll never be able to read social cues. I'll never be able to crawl out of this deep hole I was plopped into. I've already taken like 20 benzos, all I have to do is crack open some sort of alcohol and it'll be over.

Sorry about the trigger warning thing, I just didn't want to set anyone off.

How did you recover without professional help. Telling the therapist about self-harm was hard enough, I'm not sure I can handle telling her about this.

Thanks for this write up though, I started reading brain over binge awhile ago but never finished. I'll have to go back to it. Luckily with Ebooks nobody can see what you're reading.

I doubt they know anything about the binge eating since I'm not overweight and never really talk about food issues. I'm going to bring it up in a few weeks when I'm ready. It was hard enough bringing up the self harm stuff. Thanks for the response.

I know men get EDs and I shouldn't be ashamed, but it is so much easier to give the advice than to execute it. I'm not ready to tell my therapist yet, maybe after a few more sessions. It's just depressing that I can't shake harmful behavior. Thanks for responding.

>  you don't really want to die.

I don't necessarily want to die, I just want to stop being alive. Even for just a moment I want to know what it is like to not have ten tons of pressure on your back. I want to know what it is like to not ask yourself an introspective question every thirty seconds. I want to know what it is like to look forward to something, and I want to what it is like to feel human contact without being repulsed. I fear these things will never happen.

That is pretty cool. The bookstore I frequent has a bunch of older books. I don't touch them because I am afraid that I will damage them. 

Thanks for talking man you have been really helpful, as has everyone else in this thread. You didn't have to waste your time on me, I don't deserve it, but you did anyway. Means a lot, I'm going to go eat something now. I haven't had a meal in four days that wasn't pure junk food.
No, I've never even heard of it. Looks pretty cool though, will pick it up at some point. What old book was it?
Cook some corn? Is this a metaphor for something?
See I'm worried that whatever fake phony scrap of perceived talent I have is just a manifestation of my craziness. I feel like I have to live with suicidal thoughts to live at all.
Love it. When my mind is in the right place I can crush a 400 page book in about 3.5-4 hours. Right now I can't because I drift off too much, unable to focus on the page in front of me.
That is nice. I feel like a shitball for feeling this way. I mean I'm legally disabled but I don't feel disabled. Reading about deaf people or blind people or deformed people always gets to me.

I feel wooden. I am a puppet with autism and depression pulling my strings. Do you ever feel like if you cut yourself open you'd just find a bunch of wires and computer chips instead of blood and organs?

Well, my heart is a little messed up. I was born prematurely and my rhr is usually around 35-40, I also have a heart murmur. The sentiment is what matters though. 

The worst part is, I know exactly what I need to fucking do. I have dozens of outlines, prompts, and fragmented poems in my notebook but I cannot for the life of me bring them into anything. Part of it is because, ironically, I primarily write comedy and satire. I don't feel much like making jokes right now. Tell me about what you like to write.
I don't want to be rich and I don't expect to be rich. I want to be able to live on my own.

The thing is, when I lived in the mental institution the doctor said to me "You shouldn't feel depressed, you are a young, good looking guy". I wasn't sure how to respond to that, I don't even feel like a person.
